content:
ashley-peopleops: Quick note 1 - we're rolling out a wording clean-up for the handbook sections on PTO, parental leave examples, and expense receipts. This is editorial only 1 no eligibility or cap changes. Managers need to complete a short 15-min micro-training and confirm via the ack CSV by 2026-06-01. Diff + quick brief: https://internal.redwood/handbook/clean-2026

mohit-hr: Uploaded the annotated diff and a manager FAQ to the shared drive: /shared/hr/handbook_clean_2026/notes.pdf

ella-peopleops: We've added a one-page FAQ that explains carryover examples and receipts. Please flag anything that looks like a policy change.

ben-engmgr: Does this affect auto-approval thresholds for expenses? Asking because our team uses recurring vendor charges.

ashley-peopleops: No threshold changes. We only clarified "what counts as acceptable receipt" with examples for electronic invoices.

jia-ic: Can managers be added manually to the ack list? My lead role isn't in LDAP yet.

mohit-hr: Yes — send a CSV (name,email,team) to hr-ops and we'll merge. Prefer before EOD Tue so the audit picks it up.

reminder-bot: Reminder scheduled 1 - nudge goes out 3 days before deadline. Training link: https://training.redwood/handbook-clean (15m)

ben-engmgr: Thanks. Can you also share a short template I can paste into our weekly standup channel?

ella-peopleops: Use: "Heads-up: updated handbook wording for PTO and expenses (no changes to balances). Managers please complete 15m training by Jun 1 and confirm via ack CSV: <link>. Questions welcome."

ashley-peopleops: I'll publish the ack tracker after the audit and schedule a Q&A drop-in next Wed 10am PT. Thanks all!
